documents.name: The Canopy — Sample Lease.txt
pages:
FICTIONAL DEMONSTRATION DOCUMENT. Not an actual offer or executed lease.

1. Monthly rent and payment
The monthly rent for The Canopy is ₹48,000, due on or before the 5th of each month. Maintenance charges of ₹4,500 per month are separate from rent. Electricity and metered water are paid by the tenant.

2. Security deposit
The refundable security deposit is ₹1,50,000. It is returned within 30 days after handover, subject to unpaid dues and documented damage beyond normal wear and tear. No automatic repainting deduction is stated.

3. Term and notice
The sample lease has an 11-month term. Either party must give 60 days’ written notice before ending the tenancy. The document does not specify an early-termination penalty or a lock-in period.

4. Repairs and maintenance
The owner handles structural repairs and major plumbing or electrical failures not caused by tenant misuse. The tenant handles routine cleaning and replacement of consumables. Report urgent water leaks to the property manager immediately; no contact number is supplied in this sample.

documents.name: The Canopy — Community Rules.txt
pages:
FICTIONAL DEMONSTRATION DOCUMENT.

1. Pets
Residents may keep up to two domestic pets. Pets must be leashed in common areas and owners must clean up after them. Pets may not enter the swimming pool. The rules do not list breed restrictions or a pet deposit.

2. Parking
The Canopy unit includes one reserved covered parking bay. Visitor parking is subject to availability and cannot be used for long-term storage. A second permanent bay is not included.

3. Shared spaces
Quiet hours are 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. The gym is open 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. The pool is open 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM and closed on Monday mornings for maintenance.

4. Guests and alterations
Overnight guests are permitted. Stays exceeding 14 consecutive nights must be registered with the property manager. Structural alterations need written owner and association approval. There is no stated fee for registering a guest.

pages: FICTIONAL DEMONSTRATION PROPERTY. The Canopy is a 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment in Whitefield, Bengaluru. Its sample floor area is 1,240 sq ft. documents.name: Cedar Court — Sample Lease.txt
pages: FICTIONAL DEMONSTRATION DOCUMENT. Cedar Court is a 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment in HSR Layout, Bengaluru, measuring 780 sq ft. Monthly rent is ₹32,000, due by the 5th.
